blocks.text: An estimated 4.7 million Filipino adults are living with diabetes, and more than half remain undiagnosed, making it a significant health concern in the country. But getting diagnosed is only the beginning. Managing diabetes requires daily commitment, from taking prescribed medications and monitoring blood sugar to making lifestyle adjustments and attending regular checkups. As the country’s leading health and wellness retailer, Watsons believes diabetes care must extend beyond the numbers. Through its six-month Diabetes Educator Program, Watsons equips pharmacists with specialized training in diabetes management, patient counseling, and health education.
